historyHelp: Texts stay on this Mac and expire after 7 days.
emptyHelp: Close this window and press right Option in the app where you need text.
toggleHelp: Press to start. Press again to finish.
holdHelp: Recording continues while the key is held.
cleanupHelp: Qwen edits the complete text. Check its meaning in preview; use the switch to see the original.
historyOffHelp: Disabling stops saving new entries. Existing entries can be deleted in History.
permissionHelp: Allow Voxsyl Accessibility access in macOS settings to use its shortcut and insertion.
permissionRecovery: Quit Voxsyl with ⌘Q. Remove the old Voxsyl entry from Accessibility, add the current Voxsyl.app with the + button and enable access. Open the app again.
shortcutUnavailableHelp: Accessibility access is enabled, but the shortcut could not be connected. Quit Voxsyl with ⌘Q and open it again. If it still fails, try a different shortcut.
basedOnHandy: Built on open-source Handy. Thanks to its authors and community.
aboutText: Local dictation with a pearl indicator. Recording and recognition work without an account or cloud.
creditHandy: Based on Handy's open-source code. Thanks to CJ Pais and contributors for recording, resampling and keyboard handling.
creditGiga: Recognition: GigaAM by Sber / GigaChat. Local engine: transcribe-rs and ONNX Runtime.
creditFonts: Onest font: The Onest Project Authors, SIL OFL 1.1. Gentle v3 sounds were created for Voxsyl.

error.microphone: Could not record. Check your microphone and Voxsyl's microphone permission in macOS settings.
error.asr: Could not recognize the recording. Check model files and try again.
error.paste: Insertion failed. Return to the input field and try again. Your text remains in preview.
error.storage: Could not save data on this Mac.
error.busy: Wait for dictation to finish before changing settings.
error.state: Could not communicate with the app.
error.clipboard: Could not copy the text. Try again.
error.cleanup: The model did not return a complete text. Showing the original — insert it or try dictating again.
error.cleanup_model: A verified Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M file is required. Choose the previously downloaded model.
error.cleanup_long: This text is too long for experimental correction. Showing the original text.

modelMissing: No model linked · regular dictation is available
modelReuse: The file is used without copying. The model unloads from memory after one idle minute.
creditQwen: Correction: Qwen3.5-4B by Qwen, quantization by Unsloth (declared Apache-2.0). Local runtime llama.cpp (MIT). Model weights are linked separately.
